machineScope.reason: Rule 113: the harness user's area on this machine (/Users/Shared/instar-harness), provisioned per machine and never shared or replicated: the launcher, the pinned harness copy, the harness profile's home, config and work directories (its own login and transcripts), one read-only copy of the admission hook and the MCP SecretRef launcher per content digest (a changed hook adds a copy; old copies are not removed, so this part grows with each hook change), each tool turn's harness-side admission state (removed with its turn directory by the prune that keeps the newest 16), each turn's MCP credential socket directory (removed when the turn ends), and a volume's ACL mark (on the conversation's own volume). None of it is agent memory: the journal's tool-turn rows are the durable record.

Rule 113: each machine provisions its own harness user and area (/Users/Shared/instar-harness), never shared or replicated: the login custody (one record per reviewed profile reference, replaced atomically, the previous token discarded), the installed launcher, hook copy and pinned harness copy (replaced when their content differs), the harness profile, the harness's own temporary directory (its and Claude Code's temporary files, which /private/tmp now refuses it), and one ACL mark per workspace volume (removed with the volume); a turn's harness-side admission state is removed with its turn directory by prune, and a delegated session's per-step admission state keeps only the newest steps.
